system.description: When you flash back to reveal a shocking truth about a PC in front of you, roll the dice, adding the number of your conditions marked, then mark a condition.

success.value:
The news is staggering; the person you're speaking to must @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation} before they can act against you. Choose two options from the following list.

  • You have unequivocal evidence this is true.

  • The shocking truth gives you rightful claim to something they value.

  • You introduce a shocking new character who has your back.

partial.value:
The news is staggering; the person you're speaking to must @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act with desperation} before they can act against you. Choose one option from the following list.

  • You have unequivocal evidence this is true.

  • The shocking truth gives you rightful claim to something they value.

  • You introduce a shocking new character who has your back.

failure.label: Miss
failure.value: It blows up in your face; the MC will provide the details.
